# netskope_service_object (Resource)

ServiceObject Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_service_object" "my_serviceobject" {
  description = "...my_description..."
  name        = "...my_name..."
  protocols = {
    icmp = true
    tcp = [
      "..."
    ]
    tcp_udp = [
      "..."
    ]
    udp = [
      "..."
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Service object description
- `name` (String) Service object name (unique per tenant)
- `protocols` (Attributes) Protocol configuration. At least one protocol must be set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--protocols))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service Object UUID
- `type` (String) Object type — custom (user-created) or PREDEFINED (Netskope built-in, read-only) (API-computed)

<a id="nestedatt--protocols"></a>
### Nested Schema for `protocols`

Optional:

- `icmp` (Boolean) Enable ICMP
- `tcp` (List of String) TCP port numbers or ranges (e.g. "443", "8080-9090")
- `tcp_udp` (List of String) TCP+UDP port numbers or ranges (e.g. "80", "8080-9090")
- `udp` (List of String) UDP port numbers or ranges (e.g. "53", "1024-2048")

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_service_object.my_netskope_service_object
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_service_object.my_netskope_service_object "..."
```
